rows.title: The high-risk plants set's guides describe the journey the service serves
rows.detail: The set's own record of documentation drift treats a document stating something the service does not do as a defect, because a second, false specification gets read as though it were current. The served-surface reference, the guide to the set's features, the guide to the journey's flow and the table of each page's copy state all describe the journey as it stood before this work. Bringing each one to what the service does, and writing into the set's documentation that a guide changes in the same increment as the behaviour it describes, puts the drift right and stops it returning.
acceptanceCriteria: The set's served-surface reference describes the notification dashboard and the address picker as the service serves them, the picker showing eight addresses a page (repo:plantsfrontend src/server/app/sets/high-risk-plants/docs/README.md:81, 83, 91)

The guide to the set's features describes how a page ends, and what a draft's and a submitted notification's view header carries, as the service has them (repo:plantsfrontend src/server/app/sets/high-risk-plants/docs/features.md:95, 178)

The guide to the journey's flow lists the journey's sections, its task rows in the order the overview lists them, where Back goes on every journey page, and which pages carry which caption, as the journey's flow has them (repo:plantsfrontend src/server/app/sets/high-risk-plants/docs/journey-flow-and-gates.md:21, 63, 111, 248)
The table of each page's copy state lists every page in the set with the state of its copy review (repo:plantsfrontend src/server/app/sets/high-risk-plants/docs/copy-status.md:3)

The set's documentation states that a guide describing a behaviour of the journey changes in the same increment as that behaviour (repo:plantsfrontend src/server/app/sets/high-risk-plants/spec/backlog-extras.json increment docs-drift-sweep)
notes: One slice: the four guides describe one journey and a reader checks them together, so correcting them apart would repeat the same walk of the journey four times. It builds after the plants specification row (inc-278 in the existing backlog) so the specification and the guides are read against the same journey once.
The set's testing guide is left alone: it is the split-off test-hygiene branch's to change.

The wording of the consignment contact page's two return controls, which the features guide records as that page's exception, changes with the page itself on the split-off consignment-parties branch, in the same increment as the behaviour (req-2486 is held by that branch), so this row leaves that passage to it.

The five untruths the set's own documentation-drift chore names are in code comments and in the recipes rather than in a guide stating a journey behaviour, so they stay the set's own chore and get no row here.
